root_cause.text: The vulnerability arises because the `blkcg_maybe_throttle_current()` function in the blk-cgroup subsystem fails to release the `gendisk` reference acquired during throttle scheduling when lookup operations fail, due to a missing `put_disk()` call in the error handling path.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the addition of `put_disk(disk);` to the `out:` label in `block/blk-cgroup.c`, and the CVE description confirms that references acquired via `get_device()` are not released on failure paths and cannot be cleaned up later since `current->throttle_disk` is already set to NULL.
